questions.q: Who delivered the 'Acceptance Speech' in Oslo?
questions.explanation: आंग सान सू ची की ओर से उनके पुत्र अलेक्जेंडर एरिस ने यह भाषण दिया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: When was the Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Aung San Suu Kyi?
questions.explanation: आंग सान सू ची को 1991 में नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Where was the 'Acceptance Speech' delivered?
questions.explanation: यह भाषण नॉर्वे की राजधानी ओस्लो (Oslo) में दिया गया था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is Aung San Suu Kyi?
questions.explanation: वह बर्मा (म्यांमार) की एक प्रमुख लोकतंत्र समर्थक नेता हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: According to the 'Acceptance Speech', what is greater than the Nobel Prize?
options: The cause of peace and democracy
questions.explanation: भाषण के अनुसार शांति और लोकतंत्र का लक्ष्य पुरस्कार से कहीं अधिक बड़ा है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Acceptance Speech', what does Alexander Aris say about his mother's location?
options: She is under house arrest in Rangoon
questions.explanation: अलेक्जेंडर एरिस बताते हैं कि उनकी माँ आंग सान सू ची रंगून में नजरबंद (house arrest) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the ultimate dream of Aung San Suu Kyi according to the speech?
questions.explanation: उनका अंतिम सपना एक स्वतंत्र और लोकतांत्रिक बर्मा (म्यांमार) का निर्माण करना है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which great civil rights leader is mentioned in the 'Acceptance Speech'?
questions.explanation: भाषण में शांति और समानता के प्रतीक मार्टिन लूथर किंग जूनियर का उल्लेख किया गया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the speech say about the students and monks of Burma?
options: They are sacrificing their lives for freedom
questions.explanation: बर्मा के छात्र और संन्यासी लोकतंत्र और स्वतंत्रता के लिए अपना जीवन बलिदान कर रहे हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the predominant tone of the 'Acceptance Speech'?
questions.explanation: भाषण का स्वर अत्यंत प्रेरक, गरिमामय और दृढ़ संकल्पित (resolute) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of 'Once Upon a Time'?
questions.explanation: 'Once Upon a Time' की लेखिका टोनी मॉरिसन (Toni Morrison) हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How is the old woman described in 'Once Upon a Time'?
questions.explanation: कहानी में वृद्ध महिला को अंधी लेकिन अत्यंत बुद्धिमान (blind but wise) बताया गया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who came to visit the old woman in 'Once Upon a Time'?
questions.explanation: कुछ युवा लोग (young people) उस वृद्ध महिला की परीक्षा लेने आए  थे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What question did the young visitors ask the old woman?
options: Is the bird in my hand living or dead?
questions.explanation: युवाओं ने पूछा कि उनके हाथ में मौजूद पक्षी जीवित है या मृत।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the 'bird' symbolize in 'Once Upon a Time'?
questions.explanation: इस कहानी में 'पक्षी' भाषा (Language) का प्रतीक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Toni Morrison describe the young visitors in her essay?
questions.explanation: टोनी मॉरिसन युवा आगंतुकों को थोड़ा घमंडी लेकिन जिज्ञासु (arrogant but curious) बताती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the old woman's exact response to 'Is the bird living or dead?'
options: I don't know, but it is in your hands
questions.explanation: वृद्ध महिला कहती है: 'मैं नहीं जानती, लेकिन यह तुम्हारे हाथों में है।'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does Toni Morrison say about 'dead language' in her essay?
options: It is unyielding and censors thought
questions.explanation: मृत भाषा कठोर होती है और वह स्वतंत्र विचारों को दबाती (censors thought) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does 'living language' do according to 'Once Upon a Time'?
options: It connects people and reaches toward the ineffable
questions.explanation: जीवंत भाषा लोगों को आपस में जोड़ती है और मानवीय संवेदनाओं को व्यक्त करती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What happens at the end of the story 'Once Upon a Time'?
options: The young people share their own beautiful story
questions.explanation: अंत में युवा लोग अंधी महिला के साथ अपनी खुद की एक सुंदर कहानी साझा करते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of the poem 'The Empty Heart'?
questions.explanation: यह कविता पेरियासामी थूरन (Periasamy Thooran) द्वारा लिखी गई है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the rich man given by the Kalpaka tree in 'The Empty Heart'?
questions.explanation: कल्पक वृक्ष ने अमीर आदमी को सोने से भरे सात घड़े दिए थे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the condition of the eighth pitcher given to the rich man?
questions.explanation: आठवां घड़ा आधा भरा हुआ (half-full) था।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What did the rich man try to do with the eighth pitcher?
options: He gave it to the poor
He tried to fill it with gold
questions.explanation: अमीर आदमी ने दिन-रात मेहनत करके उस आठवें घड़े को सोने से भरने का प्रयास किया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the moral of the poem 'The Empty Heart'?
questions.explanation: इस कविता का मुख्य संदेश यह है कि लालच का कोई अंत नहीं होता (Greed is endless)।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Empty Heart', what does the Kalpaka tree symbolize?
options: A wish-fulfilling entity and divine bounty
questions.explanation: कल्पक वृक्ष को हिंदू पौराणिक कथाओं में मनोकामनाएं पूर्ण करने वाला देववृक्ष माना जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did the rich man lose his health and appetite in 'The Empty Heart'?
options: Because he worked day and night to fill the eighth pitcher
questions.explanation: आठवें घड़े को सोने से भरने की चिंता में अमीर आदमी ने अपना स्वास्थ्य और भूख खो दी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the literal meaning of 'Kalpaka' in Indian mythology?
options: A mythological tree that grants all desires
questions.explanation: कल्पक (कल्पवृक्ष) का अर्थ है वह वृक्ष जो मांगने पर सभी इच्छाएं पूरी करता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does Periasamy Thooran describe the rich man's final fate?
options: He died before he could fill the pitcher
questions.explanation: घड़ा भरने की अंधी दौड़ में अमीर आदमी घड़ा भरे बिना ही मृत्यु को प्राप्त हो गया।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the core psychological insight of the poem 'The Empty Heart'?
options: Material accumulation cannot satisfy a spiritual void
questions.explanation: भौतिक वस्तुओं का संग्रह मनुष्य के आंतरिक खालीपन (spiritual void) को नहीं भर सकता।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Who is the author of the poem 'Koel'?
questions.explanation: यह प्रसिद्ध कविता पूरन सिंह (Puran Singh) द्वारा रचित है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the Koel ask the lightning in the poem?
options: Why are you sleeping among the leaves?
questions.explanation: कोयल बिजली से पूछती है कि वह पत्तों के बीच क्यों सो रही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why is the Koel restless in the poem?
options: Because she is separated from her beloved
questions.explanation: अपने प्रियतम से वियोग के कारण कोयल अत्यंत बेचैन (restless) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the Koel's song do to the poet?
options: It wakes a thousand memories in his heart
questions.explanation: कोयल का गीत कवि के हृदय में पुरानी यादों को जगा देता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What color is the Koel mentioned in the poem?
questions.explanation: कविता में कोयल के काले (Black) रंग का उल्लेख किया गया है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'Koel', what does Puran Singh compare the Koel's notes to?
options: Sparks of fire that burn his soul
questions.explanation: कवि कोयल की कूक को आग की चिंगारियों के समान मानता है जो उसकी आत्मा को जला देती हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why does the Koel conceal herself among the mango leaves in the poem?
options: To sing her melancholy song in secret
questions.explanation: कोयल आम के पत्तों के बीच छुपकर विरह का अपना दर्द भरा गीत गाती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the effect of the mango blossoms on the Koel?
options: They ignite her passion and longing
questions.explanation: आम के बौर (blossoms) कोयल के हृदय में प्रेम और विरह की आग को और भड़का देते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: How does the poet respond to the Koel's question about lightning?
options: He throws a third stone at her
He is deeply moved by her intensity
questions.explanation: कोयल की तीव्र विरह-वेदना देखकर कवि का हृदय अत्यंत भावुक हो उठता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the predominant emotion expressed in the poem 'Koel'?
questions.explanation: इस कविता में प्रियतम से मिलन की तीव्र लालसा और विरह (Biraha) का भाव प्रमुख है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: Ram eats a mango.
options: A mango was eaten by Ram.
A mango is being eaten by Ram.
A mango is eaten by Ram.
questions.explanation: Present Simple का पैसिव 'is/am/are + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: She is singing a song.
options: A song is being sung by her.
A song was being sung by her.
A song has been sung by her.
A song is sung by her.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous के पैसिव में 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: The window was broken by the boy.
options: The boy has broken the window.
The boy is breaking the window.
questions.explanation: 'Was broken' Past Simple का पैसिव है, अतः एक्टिव में V2 (broke) लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: They have won the match.
options: The match has been won by them.
The match have been won by them.
The match was won by them.
The match is won by them.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect के पैसिव में 'has/have + been + V3' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: A book was given to me by her.
options: She has given me a book.
She is giving me a book.
questions.explanation: 'Was given' Past Simple का पैसिव है, इसलिए एक्टिव V2 (gave) होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: They are building a new bridge.
options: A new bridge is being built by them.
A new bridge is built by them.
A new bridge was being built by them.
A new bridge has been built by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous के पैसिव में 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: Nobody can solve this problem.
options: This problem can be solved by nobody.
This problem could not be solved.
questions.explanation: 'Nobody' वाले नकारात्मक वाक्यों के पैसिव में 'cannot be + V3' का प्रयोग बहुत मानक है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: English is spoken all over the world.
options: People spoke English all over the world.
People speak English all over the world.
English speaks all over the world.
People are speaking English all over the world.
questions.explanation: जब पैसिव में Subject स्पष्ट न हो, तो एक्टिव में 'People' या 'We' को Subject मान लिया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: He made me laugh.
options: I was made to laugh by him.
I was made laugh by him.
He was made to laugh by me.
I am made laugh by him.
questions.explanation: 'Make' के पैसिव में 'to + V1' (Infinitive with to) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य रूप से होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: The thief was arrested.
questions.explanation: गिरफ्तार करने का काम पुलिस का है, अतः एक्टिव में 'The police' Subject बनेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into passive voice: Who wrote this letter?
options: By whom is this letter written?
By whom was this letter written?
questions.explanation: 'Who' को 'By whom' में बदलते हैं और Past Simple के लिए 'was/were' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: The passive voice of 'Open the window' is:
questions.explanation: आज्ञावाचक वाक्यों (Imperative) का पैसिव 'Let + object + be + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: Did you see the match?
options: Was the match seen by you?
Were the match seen by you?
Did the match seen by you?
Is the match seen by you?
questions.explanation: Past Simple Interrogative का पैसिव 'Was/Were + Object + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: The passive voice of 'Help the poor' is:
questions.explanation: नैतिक सलाह (Moral advice) वाले Imperative वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Object + should be + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: By whom was this picture painted?
questions.explanation: 'By whom' को 'Who' में बदलते हैं और Past Simple के लिए V2 (painted) लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: Please give me a pen.
options: You are ordered to give me a pen.
A pen should be given to me.
You are requested to give me a pen.
Let a pen given to me.
questions.explanation: 'Please' वाले वाक्यों का पैसिव 'You are requested to...' से बनाया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: The passive voice of 'Do not insult the weak' is:
options: Let the weak not be insulted.
questions.explanation: नकारात्मक Imperative वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Let + Object + not be + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: Let the door be shut.
questions.explanation: 'Let + object + be + V3' Imperative वाक्य (V1 + Object) का पैसिव रूप है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into passive voice: Who broke this beautiful glass?
options: By whom this beautiful glass broken?
Who was broken this beautiful glass?
By whom is this beautiful glass broken?
By whom was this beautiful glass broken?
questions.explanation: 'Who' को 'By whom' में बदलते हैं और Past Simple के लिए 'was/were' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct passive voice: Can you solve this puzzle?
options: Could this puzzle be solved by you?
Can this puzzle be solved by you?
Can this puzzle solved by you?
Is this puzzle solved by you?
questions.explanation: Modal Interrogative का पैसिव 'Modal + Object + be + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: सूर्य अस्त हो चुका है।
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Tense में 'has + V3 (set)' का प्रयोग सही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: मेरे पहुँचने से पहले डॉक्टर जा चुके थे।
options: The doctor left before I reached.
The doctor has left before I reached.
The doctor was left before I reached.
The doctor had left before I reached.
questions.explanation: भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में पहले होने वाली घटना के लिए Past Perfect (had left) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: हम लोग भारत के नागरिक हैं।
options: We is the citizens of India.
We are the citizens of India.
We was the citizens of India.
questions.explanation: सही और सटीक अनुवाद 'We are the citizens of India.' है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: दरवाजा खोलो।
questions.explanation: Imperative वाक्य हमेशा Verb की पहली अवस्था (V1) से शुरू होते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: मुझे जाने दो।
questions.explanation: अनुमति मांगने वाले Imperative वाक्यों में 'Let + Objective case + V1' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Tranquil'?
questions.explanation: 'Tranquil' (शांत) का पर्यायवाची 'Peaceful' (शांतिपूर्ण) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Barren'?
questions.explanation: 'Barren' (बंजर) का विलोम 'Fertile' (उपजाऊ) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the antonym of 'Optimist'?
questions.explanation: 'Optimist' (आशावादी) का विलोम 'Pessimist' (निराशावादी) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the synonym of 'Vast'?
questions.explanation: 'Vast' (विशाल) का पर्यायवाची 'Huge' (बड़ा/विशाल) है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी 'Knowledge' (ज्ञान) है।
questions.subject: English
